title: Credential Access Protection
description: Credential stores (especially LSASS) must be monitored. Unauthorized memory dumping is prohibited except for approved security tooling.
requirements: A Sigma detection rule must exist for LSASS memory dumping
Approved support tools may be excluded via explicit exceptions in the rule

title: Remote Access Control
description: Remote desktop and other remote access paths must be logged and monitored for suspicious use.
requirements: RDP connections must have a dedicated detection rule
Rules should flag non-standard source hosts or unusual account usage
Severity should reflect whether the connection is from outside trusted admin subnets

title: Account Lifecycle Monitoring
description: Creation of local accounts must be monitored to detect unauthorized persistence or backdoor accounts.
requirements: Local account creation events must be detected
Rules should focus on net.exe / net1.exe user creation patterns
Benign IT provisioning activity should be considered in false-positive risk
